timing: Saved after independent static review identified the MRR/reporting ambiguity, before the producer completed and before final metrics were inspected.
original_MRR: Producer MRR uses the reciprocal first truth rank in the complete positive-score ranking, including ranks beyond50. Label it full-positive-ranking MRR; it is not MRR@50.
original_returned_positive_candidates: Counts every positive-score candidate, not the number served. Label it positive candidate count.
supplement: Report MRR@50 separately, zero when the first true artist is beyond50 or absent. Report returned-at50=min(50,positive candidate count). Preserve original report/query files unchanged.
unchanged: Queries,source/split,features,fits,rank order,Recall10/50,bootstrap acceptance and all original values. No model or threshold changes.
